name: the-wild-provision
description: Custom Shopify theme for The Wild Provision: premium single-ingredient dog chews.

scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --names assets,shopify --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm dev:assets" "pnpm dev:shopify"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:contrast && pnpm theme:check && pnpm build
